# A miniature customer

Small enough to read in one screen, and shaped exactly like a real one: a
document that defines the prompts, and a script that carries a copy of them.

## Prompt one: outbound

```text
example is a tool. It has reported something against this project.

Address every open row.
-- or, for one row --
Find the row whose id is ID, and address that row only.

Work on branch BRANCH. Commit to it locally and push nothing.
```

## Prompt two: the follow-up

```text
A project has responded, at LINK.

Read it as two things: a triage, and a decision.

Write a postmortem entry for this run, whether or not anything changed.
-- or, with --no-postm --
Decide whether this run earned a postmortem entry.

Leave everything staged, and commit nothing.
```

## Keeping them in step
